Shaggy platinum white hair styled in a short, messy crop. Narrow, glowing yellow almond-shaped eyes. Apparent age is ancient and weathered. A tall, slender mummified build with grayish-brown linen bandages wrapping the body. Dressed in ancient Egyptian royal attire featuring a deep gold collar and a striped nemes headcloth in blue and yellow. Signature details include a floating gold sarcophagus and a small, long grayish-brown linen-wrapped tail.
BODY COLOR: grayish-brown
